verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs say the REST API gives programmatic control over the entire platform and that anything you can do in the web console can be automated from the CLI. A public OpenAPI spec and runtime probes corroborate that the CLI and API are real and working, though the probes only exercised offer search. missing for 10: independent verification of UI/API parity beyond search, and documented API paths for account signup/email verification and adding credit (the quickstart only shows the UI flow).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.
Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
The Vast.ai CLI gives you command-line access to the entire platform, authentication, GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, and more.
